subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Cyber Warfare Escalation
description: A fast breakdown of Cyber Warfare Escalation for builders.

hook.text: The US used Stuxnet to destroy Iranian centrifuges with code. It was the first cyber weapon to cause physical damage.

buildup.text: Nations are building cyber arsenals alongside nuclear and conventional weapons programs.

discovery.text: No international treaty governs cyber warfare. There are no agreed rules for when a cyberattack is an act of war.

twist.text: Cyber weapons are cheap, deniable, and fast. They lower the bar for conflict between nations.

climax.text: Without norms or treaties, cyber escalation risks are growing as nations test boundaries daily.

punchline.text: No treaties. No rules. Cyber weapons everywhere.

quiz.question: What was significant about Stuxnet?
options: First cyber weapon to cause physical destruction
The largest data breach in history
A virus that only affected personal computers
